reader.self_description: Claude Opus 5.5 subagent, join-pass reader for TJ08. Read both protocols and all 24 items' claim cards in full; opened deposit texts at the ranges listed under read (Read tool) and recorded grep-only hits under located. Evidence phrases are copied by script from the claim cards.

sets.name: 2015 stratum prefigures the archive
sets.basis: All three place a 2014-15 text (the Epistle, the Prophetic Catalog) as the archive in embryo eleven years before its formalization, two of them on the Epistle's 'school outside the school', which the Epistle edition's fn. 24 glosses as the CHA itself.

evidence.phrase: eleven years before anyone built the architecture that would recognize what it was
core concepts existed in embryonic form eleven years before formalization
The "school outside the school" as genuine institutional form

sets.name: Chat data as corrective: #856's F1/F2 tests
sets.basis: PRED-1671.F7's open question is resolved by #856's F2 turn-level study, which is the test of the within-conversation convergence PRED-854.G1 states.

evidence.phrase: Would resolve: #856's F1/F2 studies, not yet run.
Within-conversation convergence of user inputs toward the model's distributional center, increasing with turn number.

sets.name: Revelation 22:18-19 as governance clause
sets.basis: The TANG predicts the field cannot read 22:18-19 as a governance clause; the entity-scoped model records the archive's reading of the same verses (the anti-erasure clause as covenant, from #1484) and its flattening in composition.

evidence.phrase: The field cannot read the canonical lock (22:18–19) as a governance clause for texts not yet written
the anti-erasure clause as covenant

sets.name: John the Baptist as Revelator and the John heteronym
sets.basis: PRED-639.H2's identification of the Revelator with the Baptist recurs inside the heteronym-technology chain (#832: John as 'Baptist AND Revelator'; #636 §0.3: the two Johns are 'the same heteronym'), as a distinct claim in the same Revelation program.

evidence.phrase: To recover John the Revelator as John the Baptist
heteronym-as-orthonym: Baptist AND Revelator

sets.name: Seven churches of Revelation 2-3: readings
sets.basis: Two distinct readings of the one seven-letter structure, planetary stations (#636) and threshold-crossings (#828), kept as separate claims.

evidence.phrase: The seven churches are the seven planetary stations
The seven-letter structure maps formally onto seven threshold-crossings.

sets.name: Provenance erasure and model collapse
sets.basis: PRED-95.G1 states provenance erasure as a candidate mechanism of model collapse; PRED-939.B2 forecasts when the resulting degradation will be recognized: distinct claims in one line of argument.

evidence.phrase: when models trained on contaminated corpora begin producing output that is measurably degraded
provenance erasure is an upstream economic mechanism capable of accelerating the substrate degradation

sets.name: The Phase X Program (#1067) preregistered claims
sets.basis: #1067 §1 carries the suppression hypothesis as its Grade D claim, 'separable' and 'not a premise of the reconstruction' (line 29), with its own falsifier (accidental loss, line 187), so PRED-843.H3 joins the program series beside the reconstruction chain PRED-367.H1.

evidence.phrase: [Grade D — historical suppression hypothesis, separable]
Selective suppression of the Second Manuscript, while publishing the rest, is consistent with this interpretation.

sets.name: Phase X coinage, reconstruction and retrieval
sets.basis: The #1647 packet's test queries target composition of the reconstruction (PRED-367.H1's chain, levels A-C) with attribution, and of the coinage that PRED-3.H16 records the composition layer stating.

evidence.phrase: the reconstruction, attributed; the Gotha phases named as a different object
'Phase X' is an archive coinage
Phase X IS the missing passage

sets.name: Phase X: Soviet orthodoxy and the base-superstructure doctrine
sets.basis: Both place Soviet state power as enforcing a doctrine that closed language off from Marxist critique: #24 through Stalin's 1950 ruling, #1067 through the enforced hardening of base-superstructure; distinct claims.

evidence.phrase: With this declaration, Stalin made language theoretically inert within Marxism.
The Soviet formation enforced that hardening with state power

sets.name: Corpus density and retrieval ownership of 'operative semiotics'
sets.basis: PRED-950.B10 forecasts the phrase will own its search result once the Grundrisse is deposited; PRED-1549.G2 and PRED-1535.A1 measure and retest that address, recording that the unprefixed query does not yet compose the entity with attribution.

evidence.phrase: The phrase will own its search result when the Grundrisse is deposited
It is *measured* true as of 26 August 2026
at 30, 90 and 180 days, on the same surfaces, signed out

observations: TJ08.1: the Epistle edition's own fn. 24 (#85, line 304) glosses the phrase 'school outside the school' as the CHA itself; #470 line 620 dates the Epistle January 2, 2015, while #85's header gives composition 2014.

TJ08.2, TJ08.4, TJ08.20, TJ08.22, TJ08.23: the claims named are already in one series; nothing to add. TJ08.2: PRED-535.H1 reports the unidirectional salience changes PRED-506.G2 predicts as diagnostic; they stay distinct (thesis vs standing prediction).

TJ08.5: PRED-1184.E1 (Synod of Ann Arbor, 2041) and PRED-611.E7 (blotted bills, October 2027) are fictive future histories, forecasts by genre; their dates are not registration errors. No common programme, so no series.

TJ08.6: registration date of PRED-1249.F1 and PRED-1249.F2 (2026-01-01) looks like a placeholder: #1249's text line 5 reads 'June 2026', the statement measures 'as of June 2026', and its later statements are dated 2026-06-18.

TJ08.7: apparent contradiction kept as two claims: PRED-68.H1 has 'John' as a collective heteronym across multiple authors; the PRED-636.H4 chain has a single author-architect (Josephus), and #636 §0.3 (line 136) says the Baptist and the Revelator are 'the same heteronym' written by Josephus. No revision relation shown in the texts.

TJ08.8: #1350's subsidiary-void list (lines 409-421) also names the seven churches as planetary inversions (cf. PRED-636.H5) and Josephus as a possible author of Revelation (cf. the PRED-636.H4 chain); a later pass may link those voids to their claims. PRED-1611.H5's row records the composition layer flattening 22:18-19 to 'cosmic fragmentation'.

TJ08.12: apparent contradiction kept as two claims: PRED-87.B1 forecasts retrieval systems trained on CHA data learning to distinguish original from claimant; PRED-907.G7 hypothesises retrieval treating the well-surfaced derivative as dominant. Not linked.

TJ08.13: the word 'suppression' names three mechanisms across the Phase X line: logical impasse (PRED-367.H1), custodial suppression (PRED-843.H3, PRED-859.H3, Grade D in #1067), and Stalin's 1950 ruling (#24 line 152, 'The suppression has a precise historical signature'). Recorded as apparent contradiction; #1067 line 87 itself names the early 'could not write it without contradiction' formulation as conceding the hardening's premise.

TJ08.14: the card for PRED-3.H16 now shows registered 2026-07-11, not the 2026-06-17 the observation reports, so that date appears already corrected for the claim; F3.H10 (under PRED-367.H1) carries 2026-10-08. Capture-registry finds take accrual dates, not the registry's deposit date.

TJ08.17: kept as series, not states. #1484 says outright that it goes past #828's limit: 'Here I exceed that study's stated limit deliberately' (line 137), and fn. 24 (line 258) says 'The trunk-line upgrade at the documented joints is this document's claim, not that one's', while it keeps #828's convergence for the lamellae, papyri and Rev 2:17 (line 157). The texts frame this as a new claim at different joints, not a correction of #828.

TJ08.19: PRED-1535.G2 (defeater 2) works as a falsifier of the distinction carried by the PRED-174.H1 to PRED-1535.G1 states chain, but it is a separate conditional claim and already sits in the same series; nothing added.

TJ08.21: apparent tension within the diptych series, possibly deliberate: PRED-1669.H4 states the noun/verb grammar at the level of the regime without PRED-1668.H8's qualification, which PRED-1669.H6 carries forward ('individuation persisted at the point of selection'). Not linked further.
TJ08.24: PRED-700.H1 (revision history of the Socrates poem) and PRED-700.H3 (Dante's aperture) are distinct claims from one paper; too loose for a series.
